violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Raw chicken stored above milk, side the upright refrigerator open the cook-line.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. Observed concentration was noted top be zero ppm. Also, there was no detergent in the deterrent bottle, at the time of the inspection of the machine.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. The machine was primed by the CFM , during the inspection. The detergent bottle/container was replaced.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: linguini pasta=45-48F, marinated shrimp=44F, sliced sausages=46F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Do north leave the drawer refrigerator doos opened when not in use. Close the drawers immediately after food is taken. CORRECTED.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERBVED unmarked squeeze bottles ands unmarked containers holding foods that are hard to identify, were not labeled to identify contents..
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no CHLORINE test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a CHLORINE SANITIZER TEST kit. KIT PROVIDED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the DISH WASHING MACHINE was observed using folded cardboards to support legs to create balance.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Provide adequate legs or adequate leg support, and not cardboard, top balance the machine

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the cook line was being used as a storage facility and for cleaning for small utensils such as spatulas.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used ONLY for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name.Observed toxic cleaning chemicals in unmarked spray bottles, without labels, to identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.CDI-paper trowels were provided at each hand sink, during the inspection.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: Salmon, Smoked Whiting, catfish. These items are being served undercooked to customers if requested.
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter from the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: Interior surfaces of the ice machine, soda fountain knobs.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. Clean these surfaces more frequently.

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Written Procedures
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not prepared and stored according to written procedures: CHICKEN WINGS.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be prepared and stored according to written procedures that have obtained approval from the regulatory authority, are maintained in the food establishment and are available to the regulatory authority upon request, describe hot the requirements are to be monitored and documented and corrective actions taken, describe how the foods are to be marked as foods that must be further cooked, describe how the foods are to be separated from ready-to-eat foods.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Sliced tomatoes =48F, roasted tomatoes =44F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Sliced tomatoes were discarded during the inspection. The roasted tomatoes to be on Time as public health control.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: Side Salmon, smoked salmon, salmon BLT, catfish , steak, fried eggs, two eggs, pan seared salmon, house Rubbed steak & eggs, crab cake Benedict.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. (Remove the asterisk from the Tail ofTwo Fish, on the menu)

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the quaternary ammonium compound(QAC) solution used to soak wet wiping towels was measured at <150 ppm. This concentration is less than the minimum 200ppm on the label of the chemical package, as the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of QAC solution within 200ppm and 400ppm as indicats on the label. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit.

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticides
violations.observation: Restricted use pesticides do not meet the requirements in 40 CFR 152 Subpart 1 Classification of Pesticides. A non-commercial insecticide (Hot Shot Flying Insect) was noted in the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Restricted use pesticides that do not meet the requirements of 40 CFR 152 may be toxic, which may result in the contamination of food. Use approved commercial pesticides that are approved to be used in food establishments, and should only be applied by pest control service professionals. Milk and Honey (Inspection Date: 05/14/2025) Page 2 of 5

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Bottles a of toxic cleaning chemicals with observed stored next to food at the coffee station, at the front serving station/bar.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed unmarked spray bottle containing toxic chemical was not labeled to identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI-Bottle was properly labeled, during the inspection.

violations.title: Food Thermometer, Repair and Calibration
violations.observation: The food temperature measuring device was found out of battery or not operating properly.
violations.corrective_action: Food thermometers shall be calibrated in accordance with manufacturer's specifications as necessary to ensure their accuracy. It is suggested that food thermometers be calibrated at least once a week in a cup completely filled with ice and cold water to a temperature of 32F or calibrated in a pot of boiling water at 212F. replace the battery, or replaced the thermometer.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: Two refrigerators on the cookline
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: sauces in squeeze bottles and ground spices.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. A food employee was observed wearing bracelets while she handling food.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Wet wiping towels were observed on work tables and not in sanitizing solution, in-between use.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CDI

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Knife was observed stored in-between two refrigerators, on the cook-line.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI- knife was relocated during the inspection.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that clean singlet service cups and plates,were stored on the floor, at the Wait area and in the back work area that exposed them to possible contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no Quarternary Ammonium Compound test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIUM COMPOUND test kit.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: shelf under prep tables, exterior surfaces of the dish washing machine, surface of the pipes under the 3-compartment sink., and compartments under deep fryers, surfaces under work tables including the breading station.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Milk and Honey (Inspection Date: 05/14/2025) Page 3 of 5

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The sink basin at at the 3-compartment sink is slow to drain or n it draining at all.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Unclog THE WASH COMPARTMENT ‘S DRAIN for proper draining.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor under stationary equipment such as stove, deep fryer, ovens, and refrigerators, is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed openings on the ceiling tiles. Burned-out ceiling light bulb under the hood.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.Seal the opening open the ceiling to prevent pests from entering the facility and protecting food and food contact surfaces from, being contaminated by dust and debris from the rafters. Replace the burned out bulb to provide adequate illumination.
